name: agentic-ai-workspace
description: Autonomous AI Workspace MCP Server featuring real-time Tavily search, Yahoo Finance market data, deep GitHub analytics, AST safe math computation, and styled email formatting.
author: Ambuj Kumar Tripathi

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information, news, facts, or real-time data using Tavily API.

tools.name: fetch_webpage
tools.description: Fetch and extract clean text content from a specific webpage URL.

tools.name: get_stock_price
tools.description: Get real-time stock price, day range, market cap, and valuation metrics for a ticker symbol.

tools.name: get_github_repo_stats
tools.description: Fetches real-time statistics for a public GitHub repository including stars, forks, and open issues.

tools.name: search_github_repositories
tools.description: Searches for public GitHub repositories based on keywords and language.

tools.name: get_github_user_profile
tools.description: Fetches public profile statistics for a GitHub developer.

tools.name: calculate_expression
tools.description: Safely evaluates a mathematical expression using an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST).

tools.name: format_email_template
tools.description: Formats raw text or markdown email content into an HTML email template.
